name: ICI Confluence
author: dan
description: Impulse-Correction-Impulse strategy. Identifies a structural impulse on a higher TF, waits for price to retrace into a multi-zone confluence area, then enters on the second impulse via POC touch or candlestick confirmation.

timeframes.note: Flexible — use any two or three TF combination. Impulse on higher TF, correction on mid TF, entry on lower TF. Same TF acceptable if setup is clear.

impulse_conditions.description: Conditions that define a valid Impulse 1

rules.name: Structure break
rules.condition: CHoCH or BOS confirmed on impulse TF by SMC Structure v2

rules.name: Momentum confirmation
rules.condition: Kernel AO > 0 for bullish impulse | Kernel AO < 0 for bearish impulse on impulse TF

correction_conditions.description: Price must retrace into a minimum of 2 confluence zones before entry is considered

zones.description: 61.8%–79% retracement of the impulse range (Optimal Trade Entry)
Order Block from SMC Structure v2 within the impulse range
Fair Value Gap from SMC Structure v2 within the impulse range
Price touching or beyond the outer NWE band
TPO Point of Control within the correction area

correction_conditions.invalidation: Price closes beyond the origin of Impulse 1 (>100% retracement) before entry — setup is void

entry_rules.name: POC Touch — Immediate Entry
entry_rules.condition: Price is inside FVG AND touching NWE band AND touches TPO POC
entry_rules.action: Enter immediately at POC touch. No candlestick confirmation required.
entry_rules.direction_long: All three zones present on bullish correction
entry_rules.direction_short: All three zones present on bearish correction

entry_rules.name: Candlestick Confirmation Entry
entry_rules.condition: Price is in 2+ confluence zones but TPO POC not present or not touched
entry_rules.action: Wait for a strong reversal candlestick pattern at the zone

stop_loss.description: Stop is placed just beyond the swing low (long) or swing high (short) that started Impulse 1. A close beyond this level means >100% retracement and full setup invalidation.
stop_loss.note: Add a small buffer (e.g. a few pips beyond the wick) to avoid stop hunts

take_profit.primary: First FVG beyond the Impulse 1 high (long) or Impulse 1 low (short)
take_profit.description: Target the nearest FVG on the other side of the impulse — this is where price is likely to reach and fill the imbalance
take_profit.note: If no FVG is present beyond the impulse high/low, use the next structural level (prior swing high/low)

notes: Tier 1 setups (FVG + NWE + POC) are the highest probability. Tier 2 requires patience — wait for the candle to close before entering. Multi-TF alignment strengthens both tiers.
